title: Khaju Bridge
visualBrief: Whole surviving Khaju stone/brick bridge-dam: exact original22vertex mapped bridge outline and native crossing alignment; complete lower pointed flow-vaults/piers/breakwaters, intrinsic weir/platform/stepped aprons, upper open pedestrian gallery and narrow pointed bays on both faces, projecting central royal pavilion with its different face divisions, square endpavilions and parapet/flatroof. Exclude river/riverbanks/moderncity/landscape/people/flags/floodlight/reflections and standalone shrines/artifacts; no opaque block spanning archvoids. The two exact original photos already inspected show different central pavilion face divisions:2009oblique two-big-archface and2023nearfront threebig/twosmallface. Preserve both side elevations, their pointed outerarches and real transverse flow/corridor passages; central royalbelvedere, endpavilions, local tile/brick trim and stone weir/step apron are intrinsic. Main longaxis and all22foot vertices remain native. Use currentphoto to count principal flowarches versus smaller approach/upperchamber bays; source texts use incompatible18/23/26span definitions, not an exact universally agreed census. Do not choose baycount from polygon vertexcount. Photographic fine/census/hidden underwater section can be bounded. Daylight brick/stone/plaster palette must not inherit amber floodlights. Freeze independent bank/river field first; datumY0at north approach, archpiers descend belowwalkway. Whole exterior, no end-only/flatdeck proxy.
